reasoning_trace.value: The paper includes several figures, including Fig. 1, which shows the considered scientific monitoring and reliable telecommunications (SMART) network, and Fig. 2, which depicts the experimental demonstration setup of the proposed SMART system. reasoning_trace.description: Explain the System Mechanism and ISAC Coupling Mode found.
reasoning_trace.value: The proposed system uses frequency modulation (FM) and optical single-sideband (SSB) modulation to integrate sensing and communication in subsea SMART networks. The sensing information is converted into multiple frequency subcarriers that reside near the communication spectrum without interference.

reasoning_trace.description: Validate the physical consistency of reported metrics (Rate/Resolution).
reasoning_trace.value: The paper reports a temperature monitoring resolution of 0.0625°C, which matches the resolution limit of the DS18B20 sensing probe used. The frequency estimation error gradually stabilizes as the DFT length increases, and the use of a frequency multiplier allows for smaller frequency fluctuations, highlighting its advantage in enhancing resolution.

reasoning_trace.description: Identify the solved problems and remaining open challenges.
reasoning_trace.value: The proposed system addresses the challenge of integrating sensing and communication in subsea SMART networks, achieving ultra-dense multiplexing and real-time temperature monitoring. However, the paper does not discuss the scalability of the proposed ISAC configuration for multiple-span links in detail, which remains an open challenge.
